'''ZA-99 Mine''' was a floating explosive miniprobe model used during the [[war against Zakuul]]. [[Alirra Semhess]] used several ZA-99 Mines while fighting off intruders on the [[X7-Cratus]] space station.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
ZA-99 Mines appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the final boss fight of the "Trial and Error" Uprising.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
